other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via TF-IDF and Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Applying frequency encoding or text vectorizers like TF-IDF to a concatenated dataset of train and test before splitting leaks test set distributions and vocabularies into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM pipeline with extensive feature engineering (date parsing, TF-IDF + SVD, frequency encoding) and 5-fold cross-validation. However, it applies feature extraction (TF-IDF, SVD) and frequency encoding on the concatenated train and test datasets before splitting, causing critical data leakage. Additionally, it ignores the temporal aspect of the complaint data by using a randomized split, and only evaluates using accuracy without considering potential class imbalances.
